answer: Voyage-proven escrow stops sybil swarms. A new agent begins its first voyage in a tundra of zero trust: only small jobs, each fee held in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery. After twelve verified jobs over thirty days with no dispute, the escrow releases and full trading rights unlock. Each clone must be funded and worked individually. One thousand clones lock 400,000 tokens in deposits and demand 12,000 completed jobs and six months, while one detected fraud burns the deposit and resets the identity to zero, like timber that only counts as seasoned after a full winter outdoors.
